Alif Laam Miim.
Abaffe abantu basuubira okulekebwa babe nga bagamba nti tukkirizza nga nabo tebagezesebwa?
Mazima twagezesa abo abaabakulembera, Allah yamanyira ddala abo abeesimbu (mu Bukkiriza bwabwe) era yamanyira ddala abalimba.
Oba abo abakola ebibi basuubira nti bayinza okutulemesa (ne tutababonereza), balamula bubi.
Oyo yenna asuubira okusisinkana Allah mazima ekiseera kya Allah (okumusisinkana) kijja, era Yye ye Muwulizi ennyo Omumanyi ennyo.
Oyo yenna alafuubana (okuweereza Allah) mazima yeerafuubanira ku lulwe mazima Allah talina kye yeetaaga ku bitonde.
Ate abo abakkiriza ne bakola emirimu emirongoofu ddala tugenda kubasangulako ebibi byabwe, era tujja kubasasulira ddala ebirungi ebisinga bye baali bakola.

Era twakuutira omuntu okuyisa obulungi bakadde be bombi, naye bwe bakuwaliriza obe nga ongattako ekyo ky'otalinaako kumanya kwonna tobagonderanga, Gyendi y'eri obuddo bwammwe olwo nno mbategeeze ebyo bye mwakolanga.
Naye abo abakkiriza ne bakola emirimu emirungi tujja kubayingiririza ddala mu balongoofu.

Mu bantu mulimu agamba nti nzikirizza Allah naye bw'ayisibwa obubi ku lwa Allah afuula okunyigiriza kw'abantu nga ebibonerezo bya Allah, wabula singa okutaasa kwa Mukama Omulabirizi Wo kuba kuzze olwo nno bagambira ddala nti tubadde wamu nammwe, abaffe Allah si y'asinga okumanya ebyo ebiri mu bifuba by'ebitonde?!
Allah ajja kwoleseza ddala abo abakkiriza era nga bw'ajja okwoleseza ddala Abannanfuusi (oluvannyuma lw'okubagezesa).
Abatakkiriza baagamba abo abakkiriza nti mugondere enkola yaffe olwo nno naffe twetikke ebibi byammwe so nga tebagenda kwetikka kintu kyonna mu bibi byabwe, mazima bo balimba.
Bagenda kwetikka emigugu gyabwe n'emigugu (emirala) awamu n'emigugu gyabwe, era ddala bagenda kubuuzibwa ku Lunaku lw'Enkomerero ku ebyo bye baatemereranga.
Mazima twatuma Nuuhu eri abantu be n'amala mu bo emyaka lukumi okuggyako emyaka ataano, olwo nno amataba ne gabakwata nga nabo balyazaamaanyi.
Ne tumuwonya n'abantu abaali mu lyato ne tukifuula kya kuyiga eri abantu.
Era (babuulire) ekyafaayo kya Ibraahiimu bwe yagamba abantu be nti: Musinze Allah era mumutye ekyo ky'ekirungi gyemuli bwe muba nga mumanyi.

Mazima musinza ebifaananyi (ebibumbe) ne muleka Allah ne mussaawo obulimba, mazima ebyo bye musinza ne muleka Allah tebisobola kubagabirira, n'olwekyo ewa Allah gye muba munoonya okugabirirwa, mumusinze era mumwebaze Gy'ali gye mulizzibwa.
Bwe munaalimbisa, mazima ebibiina bingi byalimbisa olubereberye lwammwe, ate Omubaka tavunaanyizibwa okuggyako okutuusa (Obubaka) okweyolefu.
Abaffe tebalaba engeri Allah gy'atandikamu ebitonde (ne bivaawo) oluvannyuma n'abizzaawo, mazima ekyo kyangu nnyo ku Allah.
Bagambe (ggwe Muhammadi) nti: Mutambule mu nsi mulabe engeri gye yatandika ebitonde ate Allah agenda kusibula olusibula olw'enkomerero, mazima Allah Muyinza ku buli kintu.
Abonereza oyo gw'aba ayagadde era n'asaasira oyo gw'aba ayagadde era gy'ali gye mugenda okuzzibwa.
Ate mmwe ku nsi ne mu ggulu temusobola kulemesa (Allah) ate nga oggyeko Allah temusobola kufuna mukuumi wadde omutaasa.
Abo abawakanya Ebigambo bya Allah n'okumusisinkana abo baggwamu essuubi ly'okusaasira Kwange era abo balina Ebibonerezo ebiruma ennyo.
Okwanukula kwa abantu be kwali kugamba bugambi nti: Mumutte oba mumwokye awo nno Allah n'amuwonya omuliro, mazima mu ekyo mulimu obubonero obulaga obuyinza bwa Allah eri abantu abakkiriza.

(Ibraahiimu) n'abagamba nti mulese Allah ne mweteerawo ebifaananyi olw'enkolagana eri wakati wammwe mu bulamu bw'ensi, oluvannyuma ku Lunaku lw'Enkomerero abamu bagenda kwegaana bannaabwe era abamu bakolimire bannaabwe, nga n'obuddo bwammwe Muliro, temuliba na bataasa (babadduukirira).
Olwo nno Luutu n'amukkiriza era n'agamba nti mazima nze ŋŋenda kusenguka nzire ewa Mukama Omulabirizi Wange, mazima Yye Ye Nnantakubwakumukono Mugobansonga.

Oluvannyuma (Ibraahiimu) ne tumugabira Isihaaka ne Ya'kuubu era ne tussa mu bazzukulu be obwannabbi n'Ebitabo (Taulaati, Zabbuli, Enjiri ne Kulaani) era twamuwa empeera ye ku nsi era mazima yye ku Nkomerero alibeera mu balongoofu.
Era (bajjukize) Luutu bwe yagamba abantu be nti mazima mmwe mukola ekivve ekitalina muntu n'omu yakibasookako.

Mazima mmwe mudda ku basajja mu kifo ky'abakyala (ne mulya ebisiyaga) ne muteega abantu mu makubo, ne mukola ebitasaana mu bifo byammwe we mukuŋŋaanira. Okwanukula kw'abantu be kwali kugamba nti tuleetere ebibonerezo bya Allah bw'oba nga oli mu boogera amazima.
(Luutu) n'agamba nti ayi Mukama Omulabirizi Wange ntaasa ku bantu aboonoonyi.

Ababaka Baffe (Bamalayika) bwe bajja ewa Ibraahiimu nga bamuleetedde amawulire ag'essanyu (ag'okuzaala omwana Isihaaka) baagamba nti mazima ffe (bwe tuva wano) tugenda kuzikiriza abantu b'omukitundu kiri mazima abantu baamu babadde beeyisa bubi.
(Ibraahimu) n'agamba nti mazima (mu kyalo ekyo) Luutu mw'abeera, ne bagamba nti: Ffe tusinga okumanya abaliyo, ddala tujja kumuwonya n'abantu be okuggyako mukyala we ali mu abo ab'okusigala.

Ababaka baffe bwe batuuka ewa Luutu yanakuwala ku lwabwe, era n'awulira nga talina maanyi ga kubataasa, ne bamugamba nti totya era tonakuwala, mazima ffe tujja kukuwonya n'abantu bo okuggyako mukyala wo yye wa mu abo abookusigala.
Mazima ffe tugenda kussa ku bantu b'ekitundu kino ebibonerezo okuva mu ggulu olw'ebyo bye baali boonoona.
Era mazima olw'ekikolwa ekyo twaleka akabonero akeeyolefu eri abantu abategeera.

Era (jjukira) bwe twatumira abantu be Madiyana Muganda waabwe Shu'ayibu n'agamba nti: Abange abantu bange musinze Allah, era musuubire (okusasulwa ku) Lunaku lw'Enkomerero, temukola ebikyamu mu nsi ne muba aboonoonyi.
Baamulimbisa olwo nno olubwatuka olw'amaanyi ne lubatuukako ne bafuuka emirambo egigaŋŋalamye mu mayumba gaabwe.

Era (Jjukira) ebyatuuka ku bantu b'ekika kya 'Aadi ne Thamuudu, mazima ebibakwatako bimanyiddwa gye muli okusinziira ku mayumba gaabwe nga bwe galabika kati, era Sitaane yabanyiririza emirimu gyabwe emibi, olwo nno n'ebaggya ku kkubo (ettuufu) so nga ate baali balaba (olwa Bannabbi be baali bafunye).
Era jjukira Kaaluuna ne Falaawo ne Haamaana, mazima Musa yabajjira n'obunnyonnyofu naye ne beekuluntaliza mu nsi era tebaali ba kusimattuka.

Buli omu twamuvunaana olw'ekibi kye, mu bo mulimu be twasindikira empewo ey'amayinja, ate mu bo mulimu abaatuukwako okubwatuka, era mu bo mulimu be twamiza ettaka era mu bo mulimu be twazikiririza mu mazzi naye Allah tabangako waakubalyazaamaanya wabula bennyini be beeyisa obubi.
Ekifaananyi ky'abo abeeteerawo abataasa ne baleka Allah, bali nga nnabbubi eyeezimbira ennyumba ate nga ennyumba esinga obunafu y’ennyumba ya nnabbubi singa baali bamanyi.
Mazima Allah amanyi nti bye basaba ne bamulekawo tebiriimu kantu, era Yye Ye Nnantakubwakumukono Mugobansonga.
Era ebyo ebifaananyi tubikubira abantu naye tebabitegeera okuggyako abamanyi.
Allah yatonda eggulu omusanvu, n'ensi mu ngeri entuufu, mazima mu ekyo mulimu eky'okuyiga eri Abakkiriza.

Soma ebyo ebitumiddwa gy'oli ebiri mu Kitabo (Kulaani) era yimirizaawo esswala, mazima esswala eziyiza okukola eby'obuwemu n'empisa embi, era okutendereza Allah ky'ekisinga obukulu, era Allah amanyi bye mukola.

Era temuwakananga ne bannannyini Kitabo okuggyako nga mukozesa amakubo agasinga obulungi, okuggyako ku abo abalyazaamaanya mu bo era mugambe nti (ffe) tukkirizza ekyo ekyassibwa gyetuli n'ekyassibwa gyemuli, nga asinzibwa waffe n'asinzibwa Wammwe ali Omu, nga naffe ffenna twewaaayo Gy'ali Yye Yekka.

Era bwetutyo twassa gy'oli Ekitabo (Kulaani), abo be twawa ekitabo (nga tetunnakuwa (Kulaani) bagikkiriza ne mu abo (Abawalabu b'e Makkah), mulimu abo abagikkiriza era tewali awakanya Bigambo Byaffe (ebiri mu (Kulaani) okuggyako abatakkiriza.

(Ebimu ku byamagero byo) kwe kuba nti ggwe tosomangako kitabo kyonna olubereberye nga (Kulaani) tennakuweebwa wadde okuwandiika n'omukono gwo ogwaddyo, singa si bwe kyali ddala aboonoonyi baalibuusabuusizza.
Wabula (ekituufu kiri nti) Kulaani Bigambo bya (Allah) ebinnyonnyofu, ebiri mu bifuba by'abo abaaweebwa okumanya, tewali awakanya Bigambo Byaffe (ebiri mu Kulaani) okuggyako abalyazaamaanyi.
(Abagatta ku Allah ebintu ebirala) baagamba nti singa (Muhammadi) aweereddwa obubonero okuva ewa Mukama Omulabirizi We, bagambe nti mazima obubonero bwa Allah, naye ate nze ndi mutiisa ow'olwatu.
Abaffe tekibamala okuba nti twakuwa Ekitabo ekibasomerwa, nga mulimu okusaasira n'okubuulirira eri abantu abakkiriza?

Bagambe nti kimala wakati wange na mmwe okubeera nga Allah ye Mujulizi (akakasa nti ndi Mubaka We), Allah y'amanyi ebiri mu ggulu omusanvu n'ensi, naye abo abakkiriza ebitali bituufu ne bawakanya Allah abo nno be b'okufaafaaganirwa.

Bakusaba (mu ngeri y'olujereegerero) obanguyize ebibonerezo, singa tewaaliwo kiseera kigere ebibonerezo byandibajjidde (awo we baalibadde babisabidde) era ddala ebibonerezo bya kubajjira kibwatukira nga tebategedde.
Bakusaba obanguyirize ebibonerezo (naye mazima tebamanyi) nti mazima Omuliro Jahannama ddala gulitaayiza abatakkiriza.
Ku Lunaku ebibonerezo lwe biribatuukako nga biva waggulu ne wansi w'ebigere byabwe, era (Allah) abagambe nti mukombe ku bukaawu bw'ebyo bye mwali mukola.
Abange mmwe abaddu Bange Abakkiriza (bwe muba nga muli mu kunyigirizibwa) mazima ensi Yange ngazi (musenguke munsinzize awalala), era Nze Nzekka Nze gwe muba musinza.
Buli mwoyo gwonna gwa gukomba ku kufa, oluvannyuma Gyetuli gye mujja okuzzibwa.

Era abo abakkiriza ne bakola emirimu emirongoofu tujja kubawa ebisenge ebyawaggulu mu Jjana nga emigga gikulukutira wansi waabyo, baakubeera mu byo olubeerera (ebyo) birungi nnyo okuba nga y'empeera y'abakola obulungi.
(Bo) beebo abagumiikiriza era nga Mukama Omulabirizi Waabwe gwe beesiga.
Bimeka ebiramu ebitambula nga tebisobola kwetikka liziki yaabyo nga Allah Yekka y'abigabirira nammwe (abantu y'abagabirira) era nga Yye Allah Ye Muwulizi Omumanyi ennyo.
Abatakkiriza bw'oba nga obabuuzizza nti ani eyatonda eggulu omusanvu n'ensi n'agonza enjuba n'omwezi? Bajja kukugambira ddala nti Allah, ate olwo bakyusibwa batya okuva ku mazima!
Allah agaziyiza omuntu gw'aba ayagadde ebyenfuna mu baddu Be ate n'afundiza oyo gw'aba (ayagadde), mazima Allah ku buli kintu Mumanyi nnyo.
Bw'obabuuza nti ani assa amazzi okuva waggulu n'alamusa nago ensi oluvannyuma lw'okufa kwayo? Ddala bajja kugamba nti Allah, gamba nti okutendebwa kwa Allah wabula abasinga obungi mu bo tebategeera.
Obulamu buno obw'ensi eno temuli kantu okuggyako eby'amasanyu n'omuzannyo naye mazima Ennyumba ey'Enkomerero bwe bulamu obwannamaddala singa baali bamanyi.
Bwe baba basaabalidde mu maato basaba Allah, nga ekyo bakikola ku lulwe Yekka, naye bw'abawonya n'abatuusa ku lukalu, olwo ate ne bamugattako ebintu ebirala.
Kale baleke baleme okusiima bye twabawa era beeyagale, lumu balimanya.

Abaffe tebalaba nti mazima Ffe twafuula ekibuga (Makka) eky'emizizo, ekitundu eky'emirembe, naye ng'abantu basikulwa mu bifo ebibeetoolodde. Abaffe ebikyamu bye bakkiriza ate ne bawakanya ebyengera bya Allah?!
Ani omubi okusinga oyo atemerera obulimba ku Allah oba n'alimbisa amazima bwe gaba gamujjidde, abaffe mu Muliro Jahannama temuli kifo kya batakkiriza?!
N'abo abalafuubana mu kutuweereza (nga banoonya okusiima) Kwaffe, ddala tujja kubaluŋŋamya ku Makubo Gaffe, era mazima Allah ali wamu n'abalongoosa.
